full_details: You were late in the house, and dinner was a dinner. The loaf was two fingers short of the notch, and the price was a penny. You did not pay for the news of Tuesday with a name. At the Theatre you read the Rose's bill, Longshanks, and you did not cross. At two the lovers were played a second time. The yard was nearly as full as Saturday. You spoke the prologue and the heart of it was steady. Nick came in under the note. You did not change a cue. You did not ask what the boxes held. You did not bring a figure home.
one_sentence: You ate with the house and kept the parlour to yourself, and at two you spoke the lovers' first line again.
title: Ate, and spoke the prologue again
